report_observations.observation: Report describes a terrain irregular triangulated network (TIN) derived from elevation contours; native TIN bytes not recovered.
Report describes ArcGIS 9.3/HEC-GeoRAS preRas geometry, channel banks, flow area, cross sections and creation of export files for HEC-RAS.
Report describes importing GIS geometry into HEC-RAS, running a steady mixed-flow simulation and generating a GIS export.
Report describes GIS postprocessing of exported HEC-RAS results, including vector surfaces, flood zones, depth and velocity files.
A plot label reads 'santaHecras Plan: Plan 01 06/10/2011'; this is a documentary search clue, NOT a verified project filename or accessible artifact.
